sources.title: Ball, Currie and Olver, Null Lagrangians, Weak Continuity, and Variational Problems of Arbitrary Order (1981)
sources.scope: Theorem3.1 general finite-order divergence; Theorem4.1 highest-order-only Jacobian classification

sources.title: Olver and Sivaloganathan, The structure of null Lagrangians (1988)
sources.scope: Lemma5 closed differential form; Lemma6 exact form and divergence; Theorem7 null Lagrangian iff divergence on star-shaped domain. Proved for first-order unconstrained fields.
sources.relation: Explains closed-form machinery; replacingDu by arbitrary four-component field changes compatibility and needs justification.

sources.title: Calderon, A note on biquadratic forms (1973)
sources.read_scope: Original publisher abstract available; full text not obtained
sources.scope: Nonnegative biquadratic forms with one binary variable group are sums of squares of bilinear forms.
sources.relation: Nine-coefficient8x8ROC lift is an established corollary already credited in capitalFE; does not prove arbitrary4x6heat-biquadraticSOS.

sources.title: Hanselka and Sinn, Positive Semidefinite Univariate Matrix Polynomials (2017)
sources.scope: Every PSD univariate real symmetric matrix polynomial has a polynomial matrixSOS factor.
sources.relation: Alternative established route to binary acousticSOS lift; no generic rational boundary feasibility assertion.

sources.title: Bruno and Pasqualotto, Quasiconvexity for the Dacorogna-Marcellini Energy (2026), arXivv1

sources.relation: Prior heat/exact-form mechanism and bi-invariantQC result; not heat-only universality and not the full nine-coefficient target.
